sv.title: Vill plötsligt träffas – efter ”jihadist”-hånet: ”En smart kille”
sv.summary: Relationen mellan president Donald Trump och Michigans nyvalde progressive senatorn Abdul El-Sayed har minst sagt varit frostig. Trump har bland annat kallat El-Sayed för ”jihadist” och liknat honom vid terroristerna bakom attackerna den 11 september 2001.

en.title: Wants to meet suddenly – after the "jihadist" jibe: "A smart guy"
en.summary: The relationship between President Donald Trump and newly elected Michigan progressive senator Abdul El-Sayed has been frosty, to say the least. Trump has, among other things, called El-Sayed a "jihadist" and likened him to the terrorists behind the attacks of 11 September 2001.
